bank_withdrawals_amounts_valid.name: bank_withdrawals_amounts_valid
bank_withdrawals_amounts_valid.value: ("bank_withdrawals"."usd_amount" IS NULL OR ("bank_withdrawals"."usd_amount" >= 0 AND "bank_withdrawals"."usd_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("bank_withdrawals"."actual_pkr_received" IS NULL OR ("bank_withdrawals"."actual_pkr_received" >= 0 AND "bank_withdrawals"."actual_pkr_received" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("bank_withdrawals"."actual_exchange_rate" IS NULL OR ("bank_withdrawals"."actual_exchange_rate" > 0 AND "bank_withdrawals"."actual_exchange_rate" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("bank_withdrawals"."fee_amount" IS NULL OR ("bank_withdrawals"."fee_amount" >= 0 AND "bank_withdrawals"."fee_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric))

bank_withdrawals_fee_pair_valid.name: bank_withdrawals_fee_pair_valid
bank_withdrawals_fee_pair_valid.value: ("bank_withdrawals"."fee_amount" IS NULL AND "bank_withdrawals"."fee_currency" IS NULL) OR ("bank_withdrawals"."fee_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_withdrawals"."fee_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "bank_withdrawals"."fee_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

expense_scope_consistent.name: expense_scope_consistent
expense_scope_consistent.value: ("expenses"."expense_type" = 'DIRECT' AND "expenses"."order_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("expenses"."expense_type" = 'SHARED' AND "expenses"."order_id" IS NULL)

financial_account_role_type_valid.name: financial_account_role_type_valid
financial_account_role_type_valid.value: "financial_accounts"."account_role" = 'UNCLASSIFIED' OR ("financial_accounts"."account_role" IN ('ETSY_RECEIVABLE', 'ETSY_PAYOUT_CLEARING', 'PAYONEER', 'BANK', 'TRANSFER_CLEARING') AND "financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'ASSET') OR ("financial_accounts"."account_role" IN ('SUPPLIER_COST', 'DIRECT_EXPENSE', 'SHARED_EXPENSE') AND "financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'EXPENSE') OR ("financial_accounts"."account_role" = 'REVENUE' AND "financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'INCOME') OR ("financial_accounts"."account_role" = 'REFUND' AND "financial_accounts"."account_type" IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE'))

posting_events_basis_valid.name: posting_events_basis_valid
posting_events_basis_valid.value: ("financial_posting_events"."amount_basis" = 'TOTAL_DEBITS' AND "financial_posting_events"."control_financial_account_id" IS NULL AND "financial_posting_events"."source_amount" > 0) OR ("financial_posting_events"."amount_basis" <> 'TOTAL_DEBITS' AND "financial_posting_events"."control_financial_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

journal_reversal_shape.name: journal_reversal_shape
journal_reversal_shape.value: "journal_entries"."reversal_of_entry_id" IS NULL OR ("journal_entries"."reversal_of_entry_id" <> "journal_entries"."id" AND "journal_entries"."source_type" = 'adjustment' AND "journal_entries"."source_event" = 'REVERSAL' AND "journal_entries"."source_id" = "journal_entries"."reversal_of_entry_id")

journal_source_required.name: journal_source_required
journal_source_required.value: "journal_entries"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("journal_entries"."source_type")) > 0 AND length(trim("journal_entries"."source_event")) > 0 AND length(trim("journal_entries"."idempotency_key")) > 0

journal_finalization_consistent.name: journal_finalization_consistent
journal_finalization_consistent.value: ("journal_entries"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "journal_entries"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("journal_entries"."status" IN ('FINALIZED', 'REVERSED') AND "journal_entries"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

journal_lines_amounts_valid.name: journal_lines_amounts_valid
journal_lines_amounts_valid.value: ("journal_lines"."debit_amount" IS NULL OR ("journal_lines"."debit_amount" >= 0 AND "journal_lines"."debit_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("journal_lines"."credit_amount" IS NULL OR ("journal_lines"."credit_amount" >= 0 AND "journal_lines"."credit_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric))

reconciliation_confirmation_consistent.name: reconciliation_confirmation_consistent
reconciliation_confirmation_consistent.value: ("payoneer_reconciliations"."status" = 'SUGGESTED' AND "payoneer_reconciliations"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) OR ("payoneer_reconciliations"."status" IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REVERSED') AND "payoneer_reconciliations"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payoneer_transactions_amounts_valid.name: payoneer_transactions_amounts_valid
payoneer_transactions_amounts_valid.value: ("payoneer_transactions"."amount" IS NULL OR ("payoneer_transactions"."amount" > '-Infinity'::numeric AND "payoneer_transactions"."amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("payoneer_transactions"."fee_amount" IS NULL OR ("payoneer_transactions"."fee_amount" >= 0 AND "payoneer_transactions"."fee_amount" < 'Infinity'::numeric))

payoneer_transactions_fee_pair_valid.name: payoneer_transactions_fee_pair_valid
payoneer_transactions_fee_pair_valid.value: ("payoneer_transactions"."fee_amount" IS NULL AND "payoneer_transactions"."fee_currency" IS NULL) OR ("payoneer_transactions"."fee_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "payoneer_transactions"."fee_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "payoneer_transactions"."fee_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

shipment_delivery_dates_valid.name: shipment_delivery_dates_valid
shipment_delivery_dates_valid.value: "shipments"."delivered_at" IS NULL OR ("shipments"."shipped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "shipments"."delivered_at" >= "shipments"."shipped_at")

supplier_purchase_items_amounts_valid.name: supplier_purchase_items_amounts_valid
supplier_purchase_items_amounts_valid.value: ("supplier_purchase_items"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR ("supplier_purchase_items"."unit_cost" >= 0 AND "supplier_purchase_items"."unit_cost" < 'Infinity'::numeric)) AND ("supplier_purchase_items"."total_cost" IS NULL OR ("supplier_purchase_items"."total_cost" >= 0 AND "supplier_purchase_items"."total_cost" < 'Infinity'::numeric))

supplier_purchase_confirmation_consisten.name: supplier_purchase_confirmation_consistent
supplier_purchase_confirmation_consisten.value: ("supplier_purchases"."status" NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED') OR ("supplier_purchases"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "supplier_purchases"."purchase_date" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("supplier_purchases"."status" <> 'DRAFT' OR "supplier_purchases"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) AND ("supplier_purchases"."confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "supplier_purchases"."purchase_date" IS NOT NULL)
